subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text:
stimulus: have you heard the name of alexander asked mr ahmed no sir razu replied how strange it is said he will you tell me about alexander please well he was the great king of Macedonia Part B : Composition (40 Marks)
guide_solution: "Have you heard the name of Alexander?" asked Mr. Ahmed. "No, sir," Raju replied. "How strange it is!" said he. "Will you tell me about Alexander, please?" "Well, he was the great king of Macedonia."
